# forumulate_status_metric (Resource)

A custom metric on a status page — what it is called, its unit, how a chart bucket folds its points, whether the page draws it, its axis and threshold line.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_status_metric" "error_rate" {
  space_id  = var.status_space_id
  key       = "error-rate"
  name      = "Error rate"
  unit      = "%"
  decimals  = 2
  threshold = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key points are pushed to.
- `space_id` (String)

### Optional

- `aggregate` (String) How a chart bucket folds its points: `avg`, `max`, `min`, `sum` or `last`.
- `axis_max` (Number)
- `axis_min` (Number)
- `decimals` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `sort_key` (Number)
- `threshold` (Number) A dashed line across the chart at this value.
- `unit` (String) Printed after each value: "ms", "%".
- `visible` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_status_metric.error_rate STATUS_SPACE_ID/error-rate
```
